name: American Honda - Midwest Consolidation Center (MCC) - Troy OH

fieldNotes.truckGate: Guarded checkpoint on the property access road off Commerce Center Blvd, ~340 m before the building; gate/barrier canopy spans the lanes (z20 satellite + Street View 2024-06).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small blue/white staffed booth (~1-2 vehicle footprint, windows on multiple sides, overhead canopy over the lanes) sits beside the gate lanes - confirmed in Street View.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a physical staffed guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Long deep approach drive plus a wide paved apron between the gate and the building affords ample inside-the-fence queuing.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-dock approach is several hundred meters of internal road - easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2; checkpoint widens into a multi-lane canopy area - approximate from imagery.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated 2; entry/exit share the one gated checkpoint.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate canopy and a long approach road give physical room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock bank on the NE building face (toward I-75) plus a second dock bank on the SW/south face; 549,000 sq ft hub handling up to 270 freighter-loads/day - well into 50+ band. Door count is an estimate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated trailer drop yard south of the building packed with parked trailers (no tractors), well over 50 stalls.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock clusters on different building faces (NE face toward I-75 and SW/south face).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial setting off I-75 in Troy OH bordered by open farmland to the south - judged Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: False for this property - the MCC building is the subject site; the older Troy PDC (idx 15) is a separate adjacent facility on the same campus, not counted here. buildingCount=2 includes the MCC's small gatehouse/annex.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated on-site trailer-storage lot south of the building, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimate combining the southern drop yard and apron staging - approximate.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; I-75 runs along the east edge but no rail.
